name: wBARL pod flash-loan bond reentrancy
summary: The wBARL WeightedIndex pod's flash() sent out the pod's entire BARL reserve and only checked its balance after the callback, so the attacker called bond() inside the callback: the bonded BARL repaid the loan and also minted pod shares. Repeating this and debonding the free shares drained the pod's BARL, which was sold for DAI and WETH.
notes: Campaign: every later successful flash() into the pod with a bond() in its callback: the attacker's second run and eleven copycat runs by four other actors over the next eight hours; flash() has no earlier exercise.

Victims are the pod and the BARL/DAI, DAI/WETH and wBARL/DAI pools the pod's BARL was dumped into, netted per transaction (loss.mjs): their WETH and DAI depletion is the realised value of the drained BARL.
BARL is unpriced; the 234,578.57 BARL that left the victim set in three copycat runs is valued at the 4,061.98 DAI the pools received for it in those runs.
